row.evidence: Freshchat's pricing comparison ticks "Single sign-on: Configure and provide SAML Single Sign On for your agents" on Free, Growth, Pro and Enterprise but lists no SCIM or provisioning, and the shared Freshworks IdP apps are SAML SSO only.
row.notes: No SCIM by absence: no SCIM in the pricing comparison, the Freshchat API reference or the Freshchat/Freshworks help centres. SSO is ticked on all four plans (Free $0 up to 10 agents, Growth $19, Pro $49, Enterprise $79 per agent/mo annual) and is configured in the Freshworks organization. The shared Freshworks Okta, Entra, Google and JumpCloud apps are SSO only. The Freshchat REST API can list, create, update and permanently delete agents and list groups and roles (Bearer API key from Admin > API Tokens), so agent lifecycle can be scripted; no IdP connector uses it.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Audit logs (UI) ticked on Enterprise only.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint documented in the Freshchat API reference or help centres; Freshworks IdP apps are SSO only.

auth.notes: API key (access token) sent as Authorization: Bearer.

endpoints.purpose: Update agent information (role, license type, groups)

audit_log_api.notes: No audit-log endpoint found; audit logs (UI) on Enterprise.

rate_limits.text: Hourly limit per business account, varies by Freshchat plan (X-RateLimit-* headers); figures not published on the page.

limitations.text: Agent objects expose is_deactivated, but the docs do not describe an endpoint to deactivate an agent; DELETE permanently erases the agent record.

okta.notes: Shared "Freshworks" OIN app (covers Freshdesk, Freshsales, Freshchat, Freshcaller, Freshmarketer); the rendered page checks SAML only, no SCIM or provisioning. No product-specific or Aquera connector for this product appears in an OIN search for "fresh".

entra.notes: Shared "Freshworks" gallery app is SSO only; users must exist in Freshworks before SSO. No Freshworks provisioning tutorial (freshworks-provisioning-tutorial returns 404).

google.notes: Freshworks is in Google's pre-integrated SAML catalogue; not in Google's autoprovisioning list.

onelogin.notes: OneLogin catalogue not loaded (blocks bots); Freshworks' SSO guide lists a OneLogin SAML configuration but no provisioning.

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud's Freshworks guide covers SAML SSO only.
